# Tokio Internet Gateway Device client

This directory contains the Tokio client from [igd-next 0.17.1](https://crates.io/crates/igd-next/0.17.1), distributed under the included MIT license. The DA peer uses this client through libp2p-upnp. The synchronous client, its HTTP dependency and its error variants have been removed. The asynchronous discovery, SOAP and gateway implementations are from the release.
